name: melanocyte inducing transcription factor

function.text: MITF encodes microphthalmia-associated transcription factor. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Waardenburg syndrome type 2 (autosomal dominant); Waardenburg syndrome type 2A (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.
